scope: Actual shipped MP RAF adapter, lifecycle callbacks and directory functions in deterministic host VM. Android/native survival remains a separate runtime check.
checks: Foreground uses original RAF, preserves timestamps and supports cancellation
Background pulse advances one pending generation, never runs cancelled/native callbacks twice
Recents compositor frames and background pulses cannot multiply frame rate; disposal drains pending work
Activity background callback releases input and preserves the same active session and child
Actual Java Join protection precedes posted UI work and survives immediate Home without duplicate service starts
Initial DNS failure is short and actionable, with no exception dump
Directory outage retains the last actual list and labels it stale; success clears the error
Live room/match fences manual, online, visibility and native resume directory fetches
Resume/network retry is bounded by cooldown, in-flight state and freshness
Native list shows directory error once and keeps independent host-return notices
